description: This PHP class 'Sass' within the Opencart admin controller namespace is responsible for generating a CSS stylesheet from a SASS (SCSS) source file. It verifies the presence of the source SASS file, compiles it using the ScssPhp compiler, and writes the resulting CSS to the appropriate directory. The class is part of the admin task for catalog styling, specifically for handling SASS to CSS conversion.

classes.name: Sass
classes.description: A controller class in the admin namespace for generating CSS from SASS files within the catalog task module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of checking, compiling, and saving the SASS stylesheet into a CSS file.
